parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline two characteristics of schizophrenia.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe token economy (Paul and Lentz, 1977) as a treatment for schizophrenia and
delusional disorder.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Discuss the ethics of using token economies as a treatment for schizophrenia and delusional
disorder.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe explanations of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate explanations of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), including a discussion of
determinism. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify two common menu design mistakes, as outlined by Pavesic (2005).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe two findings of the study by Gil et al. (2009) on shopper movement patterns.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Gil et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about choice heuristics in consumer
decision-making (availability/representativeness, anchoring and purchase quantity decisions,
pre-cognitive decisions).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about choice heuristics in consumer
decision-making (availability/representativeness, anchoring and purchase quantity decisions,
pre-cognitive decisions), including a discussion of ecological validity. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘acute’ pain.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the UAB pain behaviour scale as a measure of pain.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of the UAB pain behaviour scale.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about practitioner and patient interpersonal
skills (non-verbal communications and verbal communications).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about practitioner and patient interpersonal
skills (non-verbal communications and verbal communications), including a discussion of
quantitative and qualitative data. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a ‘continental rota’ in shiftwork.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Outline two types of bullying at work from the study by Einarsen (1999).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two weaknesses of the study by Einarsen (1999).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about group decision-making in organisations.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about group decision-making in organisations,
including a discussion of generalisations.
